releaseNotes: Fixed: web Scan Station I-V chart Power axis was mis-scaled (string-typed power value broke Recharts auto-domain), causing the curve to shoot off the top of the chart instead of curving back down - now matches the PDF export correctly. Fixed: PDF chart axis limits could go NaN and silently break a curve when a module was missing Voc/Isc/Pmax (e.g. an errored flash test). Added: Hide Status row toggle for the PDF (Configuration - PDF and Reports). Still includes in-progress ZKTeco C3-200 Plus Push/ADMS buzzer integration - NOT YET FUNCTIONAL.
